# Subway Seat for Terminal.app

The 16 ANSI colors plus background, text, bold text, selection and cursor. Terminal.app has no setting for cursor text or tab colors, and a profile doesn't switch with the macOS appearance, so pick one flavor.

[Terminal.app](https://support.apple.com/guide/terminal/welcome/mac) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/terminal-app/)

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Terminal › Settings › Profiles (select it, then click Default):

```sh
open "Subway Seat.terminal"   # imports the profile and opens a window
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Terminal › Settings › Profiles (select it, then click Default):

```sh
open "Subway Seat Tunnel.terminal"   # imports the profile and opens a window
```
